arm: Fetch 7-DoF arm (Fetch tasks only; Hand tasks have a fixed base, no arm)
success_criterion: task-specific tolerance: Fetch tasks within 5 cm of target; HandReach mean fingertip distance < 1 cm; HandManipulateBlock/Egg Full: position < 1 cm and rotation < 0.1 rad; HandManipulatePen Full: position < 5 cm and rotation < 0.1 rad ignoring the z axis
paper_code_mismatch: The maintained code's dense reward for hand manipulation is -(10*d_pos + d_rot), a weighting never stated in the paper; the maintained repo is Farama Gymnasium-Robotics (v4 env ids) rather than the original 2018 OpenAI Gym (v0 ids), and default distance/rotation threshold constants are not visible in the extracted code (signatures only).
note_gaps: No numeric success-rate values could be read from Figures 3-4 or Appendix C (axis labels/legends only, no plotted values); default distance/rotation threshold constants are not visible in the code extract.
